title: A General Language Assistant as a Laboratory for Alignment
authors: A. Askell, Y. Bai, A. Chen, et al. (22 authors)
before: Alignment was discussed abstractly or studied on narrow tasks.
problem: No concrete definition of what a well-behaved general assistant should optimise for.
breakthrough: Frame the target as helpful, honest and harmless, and use a general assistant as the testbed for alignment methods.
why: The HHH framing organised Anthropic's work and much of the field's vocabulary for assistant behaviour.
next: The HH-RLHF paper and Constitutional AI build directly on it.
inherits: Helpful, honest, harmless as the shorthand for assistant objectives.
